research_question: Which admissible chorus, melody, beat and lyric measurements are associated with observed YouTube circulation after registered adjustment and robustness checks?
population_scope: Canonical HookLab cases with verified official YouTube identity, complete circulation provenance and independently admissible multimodal features.
outcome: Primary circulation outcome must be frozen before collection; candidates are CIRC_YT_LOG_VIEW_VELOCITY_v0_1 and CIRC_YT_PEAK_VPH_v0_1.
robustness_plan: Include leave-one-artist-out, alternative age normalization, high-leverage audit and matched genre/year sensitivity; exact rules must be frozen before collection.
stop_promotion_rule: Any identity ambiguity, outcome missingness, feature inadmissibility, temporal leakage, multiplicity failure, unstable effect, unmeasured exposure bias or replication failure blocks promotion.
blocked_reason: The matrix lacks YouTube identities and circulation metrics; vidIQ has zero available credits; musical and lyric features remain outside Feature Admissibility.
